title: zelenskiy says ukraine not behind nord stream blasts cooperating with probe 2026 08 24
text:
KYIV, Aug 23 (Reuters) - Ukraine played no role in ​blowing up the ‌Nord Stream gas pipelines and is cooperating with ​an investigation into ​the matter, President Volodymyr ⁠Zelenksiy said on ​Sunday.
"Ukraine has never officially ​taken part in any operations regarding the blowing ​up of the ​Nord Stream 2 pipeline," he ‌told ⁠reporters in Kyiv.
The Nord Stream 1 and 2 natural gas ​pipelines between ​Russia ⁠and Germany were damaged in ​explosions in September ​2022, ⁠and two Ukrainian suspects are currently in ⁠custody ​on suspicion ​of involvement.
